application_credentials.description:
The simplest way is to add the **Météo-France Observation** integration directly: it asks for the value shown after `Authorization: Basic` on the portal and decodes it for you.

To enter the credentials here instead, decode this Base64 value: you get `APPLICATION_ID:APPLICATION_SECRET`. The client ID is the part before the colon, the client secret the part after it. The value is shown on the [Météo-France API portal]({portal_url}), in the curl example of **Générer token** for the [Données Publiques Observation]({api_url}) API.

user.title: Météo-France credentials
user.description: Use credentials already saved in Home Assistant, or add new ones.

credentials.title: Météo-France credentials
credentials.description:
1. Create an account on the [Météo-France API portal]({portal_url}) and sign in.
2. Open the [Données Publiques Observation]({api_url}) API and subscribe to it (free).
3. In **Mes API**, click **Générer token** for this API and pick **OAuth2**.
4. The curl example at the bottom of the page contains `Authorization: Basic` followed by a long value. Copy this value and paste it below.

The value is decoded to get the application ID and secret, which are saved in Home Assistant application credentials. Tokens are then renewed automatically.

data_description.authorization: Base64 encoded APPLICATION_ID:APPLICATION_SECRET. Pasting the whole header also works.

search.title: Find a station
search.description: Measurements come from Météo-France ground stations, which publish a new observation every 6 minutes. How do you want to find your station?

menu_options.location: Around a point on the map

location.title: Around a point
location.description: Move the pin to your home. The 20 nearest stations will be proposed, sorted by distance.

department.title: By department
department.description: Choose the department. The number of stations is shown in brackets.

manual.title: Station ID
manual.description: The station ID has 8 digits and starts with the department number, for example 75110001 for Paris-Lariboisière.

station.title: Choose the station
station.description: Each line shows the station name, its ID, the distance and the altitude. Prefer a close station at an altitude similar to your home's.

reauth_confirm.title: Check the Météo-France access
reauth_confirm.description: Météo-France rejected the requests for {station}. If you created new credentials, paste the value shown after `Authorization: Basic` in the curl example of **Générer token**. If you only fixed your subscription to the [Données Publiques Observation]({api_url}) API, leave the field empty and submit.

error.not_subscribed: The application is not subscribed to the Données Publiques Observation API.
error.no_data: This station publishes no 6-minute observation. Choose another station.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Météo-France API. Try again later.
error.unknown_station: No station with this ID. Check the 8 digits, including the leading zero.
error.invalid_format: This value cannot be decoded. Copy only the text after "Authorization: Basic".
error.credentials_changed: This application is already saved with another secret. Delete it in Settings > Devices & services > three dots menu > Application credentials, or create a new application on the portal.
error.credentials_required: The saved credentials were removed: paste the value after "Authorization: Basic".

abort.not_subscribed: The application is not subscribed to the API. Subscribe to [Données Publiques Observation]({api_url}) on the [Météo-France API portal]({portal_url}), then try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Météo-France API. Try again later.
abort.no_stations: Météo-France returned an empty station list. Try again later.
